in_marathi.name: Gitaanjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song of the Gita, Garland of the Gita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gitaanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gitaanjali is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gita' and 'Anjali'. 'Gita' refers to the Bhagavad Gita, a sacred Hindu scripture. 'Anjali' means 'garland'. Thus, Gitaanjali can be interpreted as a 'song of the Gita' or 'garland of the Gita'. The name signifies a deep connection and devotion towards the teachings of the Bhagavad Gita.
